summary.json.optimization: Persistent transposed F32 value cache; same reference matmul and softmax arithmetic; MTD_CPU_OPT=16

configuration.warmup: Primed preceding binaries/model; fresh process per measured run; includes load

summary.json.protocol: Two alternating-order repetitions for seven 60-second cases; one paired 120-second stress test. Shared loaded host; timing ranges are not latency guarantees.

quality.benchmark: OpenBench-selected VoxConverse development smoke subset, first three 60-second cuts, pinned revision
quality.WER: Not scored; annotations lack lexical reference. Full text, timestamps and speaker markers match the current native Q8 reference on all tested cases.

upstreamTests.reason: Model/tensor golden fixtures unavailable; no upstream full model parity claim

rejectedExperiments.reason: Changed German and VoxConverse output; zero-collar DER worsened on one public cut
Baseline exceeded 300 seconds under shared load; suite stopped and preserved as a failed gate

limitations: Small corpus: no full-corpus accuracy certification.
Shared host load varied; final comparisons use one worker per physical core for both variants.
The 120-second stress check has one repetition.
The candidate uses roughly 7-8 percent more peak RSS on 60-second samples.
